translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: MATYU
book.title: MATYU Matyu ere bas rasem Tuma Yenbo.

content: Jisas ere letken tewoken bulworam tame erne eyarem.
Eme erne womke, Jisas ere perek waren peik keraruke sene wum, ere eteri maime komke yim.

Yim, letken tewoken bulworam tame erne tatame eme erne tame sebe tiyke yewon sen yam. Jisas ere erne eyarte eke eme sen yam, eme eter temenem akek sen yam. Sen yam, Jisas ere lam, eme eteri mure kenawaike abom, eke ere let tewo sam tame erne etep wom. Ari yen, ne pap yenbo mette. An neri nenem wule yaper peten sepitbe. Etep wom.
Moses eri wule tuma wusoubetem tame eme etep metem, eme etemri porerek etep abom. Ete tame ere God eterneke tuma yaper woye. God eterwou ere wule yaper peten sepitbe.
Etep abomke, Jisas ere emri porere lam, ere emne wometem. Beke kem keremri porerek yaper wos etep abobe?
An ete tame erne wote. An neri sebera ya wos peten sepitte. Etep wote, e yaku eisau. O an erne etep wote. Ne wayen teten yite. An etep wote, e etepwou, e yaku eisau.

An Tatame Etemne Lan Yeirim Tame, an gwote nowselke tetan. An mureken, an tatame etemri sebera ya wos kuyese peten sepitte. Areri mure an kemne peterate. Kem late. Etep womke, ere ku let tewo sam tame erne etep wom. Ne wayen teten neri tukna rowe peten sen neri akek sene yite.
Etep womke, ete tame ere wayen teten eri akek yim.
Yim, tatame eme etep lamke, eme aken God eri sig eisau wom. Eme etep wom. God ere ete tame Jisas erne mure newom, ere wule yaper kuyese peten sepitbe. Eke eme God eri sig eisau wom.
Jisas ere Matyu erne wopetem.
Jisas ere ete emi mesginin yibetem, ere lam, tame wuri ere takis kel petbetem akek simenem. Eri sig Matyu. Ere erne lan etep wom. Ne arenken yite. Etep womke, ere wayen teten eterken yim.
Yim, sene Jisas ere Matyu eteri akek a abetem, kel nogwape petbetem tame, akeite wule yaper nenbetem tame eme yan eterken sim, eri anepoi tame etemken sin a abetem.
Sin abetem, Farisi tame eme etep lam, eme eteri anepoi emne etep wometem. Beke keremri tuma wusoube tame ere kel petbe tame etemken akeite wule yaper nenbe tame etemken a sin abe? Eme etep wometem.

Jisas ere emri wom tuma metem, ere awosein etep wom. Tame eme bepou me tetan, emne kapoyi beke kei, eme dokta erne beke yin la. Berai. Kapoyi metbe tame etemwou eme dokta erne yin labe. Kau tatame eme maime etep abobe. An tame yenbo. Etepkap tatame an emne kobo late beke ya. Kau tatame eme maime etep abobe. An tame yaper. Etepkap tatame an emne kobo late yam.

God eri bas rasem siglou etep wobe. Tatame eme ane kwar mane pete. An aboye, tatame eme akeite tatame emne kobo late. Etep wobe. Ete tuma somo kem beke met. An yam, an tame yenbo emne eyarte beke ya. An sebera yabe wule yaper nenbe tame etemne eyarte yam. Etep wom.
A takerbe yabel.

Baptais ok wirubetem tame Jon eri anepoi tame eme Jisas erne yan lan etep wom. Nema Farisi tame etemken nogwape yabel nema wule yenbo sebe, nema a takerbe. Beke yabel nogwape neri anepoi tame eme wule yenbo beke se, eme a som abe?

Jisas ere awosein etep wom. Tame ere ta panete, ere eri tamenowu emne wo yate, eme ta panen kisbe a ate. Eme oksubu tebe, eme a beke taker. Yuri ta panete tame ere sene yite, eri tamenowu eme pap yaper tete, eme a beke a, eme a takerte. Gwopte an ari anepoi tame etemken tetan, eme oksubu tebe, eme a abe.
Tame eme woyarten mate seba tetan, eme mate meg ager beke peten, etek beke kape. Etep tete, pekaten mate ere eisauwai sene pekate.

Tame eme yurik nenem wain ok kiyiri ok tibe girbu sebak beke yewo. Etep tete, yurik nenem wain ok ere wayen pelaube, girbu seba ere ek pekan ok ere selke sirpitbe. Etep tebe, girbu ere yaper tebe. Yurik nenem wain ok eme girbu agerke yewote, wain okken girbuken epe yenbo temente. Etep wom.
Jisas ere sam yen wuri tene wou sene newom, ere ta wuri tene eyarem.
Jisas ere emne tuma som wobetem, Juda etemri apeilake wuri ere yan eri bitimik gulke pan etep wom. Areri yen te saye. Ne yan tene let kerete, te sene terbo terbon yate.
Etep womke, Jisas ere erne semowun yim, eri anepoi tame eme eterken yim.
Ere yibetem, ta wuri te yan eteri kin yekwok yan eri tame oub megke kerelam. Ete ta te worta subetem, nabe ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes keyem (12-pela), te worta subetem.
Eri tame oub kerelam, teri porere te etep abom. An eri tame oub let kerelatek, an yenbo mette.
Etep abomke, Jisas ere petkwo lan tene etep wom. Yen, neri pap yenbo mette. Ne ane kenawaike abobe, eke an nene eyarte. Etepkap ne yenbo mette. Eter wobetem tuma tepken teri subetem worta omom.
Ere etep tem, ere keryen eteri akek yin wurin lam, tame eme amo puw optebetem, tatame nogwape eme keratirbetem.
Yan lam, ere etep wom. Kem seki. Yen te beke sa. Te me tuknaten. Etep womke, eme erne kenake keyatirem.
Keyatiremke, ere tatame emne wom, eme kom genik woram, ere ake purik wurin etetri letke kerem, te wayen sim.
Wayen sim, eri nenem wule tatame eme etep lam, eme komke komke wusowun sewurem.
Jisas ere le si tame pes epne eyarem.
Jisas ere ete ake mesginin yibetem, le si tame pes epe erne lelekeren yin etep wom. Ne Devit eteri nan. Ne nesetne kobo late.
Etep womke, ere akek yin wurim, le si tame epe erne yan lam. Ere epne etep wometem. Kep mapeke aboye? An kerepri le kuyese eyarte o? Epe awosein etep wom. Ye. Ne kuyese nente.
Ere epri le letke keren etep wom. Kerepri porere an laye, kep ane kenawaike abobe, eke an kepne noub nente.
Etep womke, epri le sene yenbo tem. Etep tem, Jisas ere epne koubkoub etep wom. An kepne nenyekap kep eike tame emne mane wusoute.
Etep wom, epe sene woran yim, Jisas eri nenemkap epe komri komri tatame emne wusoubetem.
Jisas ere tuma eikse tame erne eyarem.
Epe sene yibetem, tatame eme tuma eikse tame erne Jisas eterke panen yam. Gabo ere ete tame erne gulelemenem, ere tuma rebe temenem.
Panen yam, Jisas ere erne gabo erne lelem, tame ere tuma sene namdem. Tuma namdem, tatame eme wouken aken etep wom. Yenbowaike. Kiyi nema etepkap wos gwo kantri Israelke kiyi beke la.
Farisi tame etem, eme etep beke wo. Eme wobe. Gabo etemri keryen, Satan eter, ere Jisas erne mure newobe, ere gabo emne lelebe. Eme etep wom.
Jisas ere tatame emne kobo lam.
Jisas ere yin kom komke sewurbetem. Sewurbetem, ere God eteri akek wurin tuma wusoubetem, God ere kom panen site tuma emne wusoubetem. Ere akeite akeite kapoyi met tatame emne eyarbetem.

Eyarbetem, ere tatame nogwape emne lam, ere emne kobo lam. Eme por walekap, eme a newon an lakerebe tame berai. Emne lakerebe tame berai, eme mureken berai, emri porere yaper temenem. Etepkap ere emne kobo lam.

Etep temke, ere eri anepoi tame emne etep wom. Nogwape nowri awos okwoye. Ete awos pette tame eme nogwape berai. Etepkap, tatame nogwape eme God eri tuma mette abobe. Emne tuma wusou tame eme nogwape berai.
Kem now maime erne womette, ere yaku kere tame won yin tatame emne tuma wusoute. Eke tatame nogwape eme eri tuma kenawaike abon now maime eteri komke yite. Jisas ere etep wom.
